title: Cyrus and the Terminal
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Orsen Iversen, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
